function.name: musicCharts_getMostPlayed
function.description: This function retrieves the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: Music genre e.g., Rock, Pop, HipHop etc.

region.description: Region where the song popularity is to be checked

duration.description: Time duration in hours for which the music played count will be considered. default is 0

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "目前最受歡迎的流行歌曲是什麼？還請幫我找出澳洲目前最受歡迎的搖滾歌曲。" They want the most popular pop song overall (likely worldwide) and also the most popular rock song in Australia.

We have a function to retrieve the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region. We can call it twice: once for pop globally? The function requires region. For global, maybe region="worldwide" or "global". But we need to decide. The user didn't specify region for pop; they just asked "currently most popular pop song". That could be worldwide. So we can call with region="worldwide" or "global". The function signature: genre: string, region: string, duration?: number. We'll call with genre="Pop", region="worldwide". Then for rock in Australia: genre="Rock", region="Australia".

We need to use the function. We'll produce a function call.
